screens.screen: home (greeting, shipment-tracking card, direct booking / price bargaining options)
service card with origin mini-map and received driver offers
order tracking (status stepper, live map with driver markers, contact card)

notes: Flutter (Material 3, Arabic RTL). Theme from lib/config/themes/app_themes.dart + color_manager.dart (primary #25be6f, bg #f8f8f8); fonts are the repo's own JF Flat and Iconly-Broken icon font. The app is visibly work-in-progress and was drawn as the code is, not polished: (1) the home avatar and the two option thumbnails are template error illustrations (errors/18_RouterOffline.png, 19_Error.png) used as placeholders in code; (2) the first option's description is a hard-coded English placeholder ('Give us a call in order to schedule your appointment.'); (3) the tracking screen title 'Delivery Details' and the 'Rejected' button are hard-coded English; (4) budget uses a hard-coded '$'. MainWrapper (bottom nav) has its body commented out, so HomeScreen is the real landing screen and no bottom nav is drawn. Google Maps widgets are replaced by a neutral stylised map; driver markers use the repo's assets/images/marker.png. Names, phone, prices, offer messages and times are sample data (Khartoum context inferred from the driver app's default camera position). Phone/amount LTR runs are bidi-isolated per the brief. If the owner prefers a cleaner look, 2 and 3 are the stronger screens.
